knows: Exit B is for 天安门
The Palace Museum needs a ticket booked online in your own name

npcs.role: a guide at the gate of the Palace Museum
npcs.character: Patient, a little formal; used to disappointing tourists who came without a ticket.
knows: Tickets for 故宫 are booked online, in your own name, days ahead

explains.故宫: 以前皇帝住的地方，很大很大。

npcs.name: 拍照的人
npcs.role: a man taking photos of the gate
knows: The flag ceremony is at sunrise
wants: A clear view of the gate

npcs.name: 安检员
npcs.role: the security officer at the palace's gate
npcs.character: Efficient, polite, checks every name against every passport.

explains.安检: 进门以前，看你的包和护照。
explains.护照: 去别的国家要用的小本子。

npcs.name: 故宫导游
npcs.role: a guide with a microphone and a yellow flag
npcs.character: Knows every beam of the palace; talks in numbers.
knows: 太和殿 is the largest wooden hall in China
The Nine-Dragon Screen is east, the Imperial Garden north-west (in the game)

explains.皇帝: 以前中国最大的人，住在故宫。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Tap the card — in you go!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: You haven't got a transport card.
nodes.why: The attendant by the ticket machines sells the 交通卡.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Right — out through the gates.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 我坐地铁到了天安门东！
nodes.translate: I took the subway all the way to 天安门东!
nodes.why: 到 after a verb: you got there. A stamp for your first ride.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is Tiananmen! It's huge!
nodes.why: 天安门 — the Gate of Heavenly Peace — was the front gate of the imperial city. Behind it lies 故宫, the Palace Museum.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Let's go and look at the palace.

answers.en: Yes, I'm going to the Palace Museum.

nodes.translate: Hello! Going to the palace?

answers.en: No, I don't have a ticket.

nodes.translate: The palace needs a ticket. Do you have one?

nodes.say: 票要在网上买，要写你的名字。
nodes.translate: Tickets are bought online, with your name on them.

nodes.say: 好。这儿很好看，你看看吧！
nodes.translate: All right. It's beautiful here — have a look around!
A friend can buy one for you.
nodes.why: A real Beijing rule: the Palace Museum sells tickets online only, booked in your own name with your passport. 王阿姨 books everything on her phone — ask her at home (Journal → Side).

nodes.translate: Hello! Beautiful here, isn't it!
Hello! Tiananmen is just outside.

nodes.say: 你好！安检。请给我看你的护照。
nodes.translate: Hello! Security. Your passport, please.
nodes.why: The ticket is in your name, so the passport is checked at the gate. 安检 — the security check.

nodes.translate: Right, the name matches. In you go!

words.explain: 去别的国家要用的小本子。
进门以前，看你的包和护照。

nodes.translate: Hello! Please go in.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Right — out.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: This is the Hall of Supreme Harmony! It's enormous!
nodes.why: 太和殿 — the largest hall of the palace, where emperors were crowned. The dragon is everywhere here: on the roofs, the throne, the steps.

nodes.say: 你好！九龙壁在东边，御花园在西边。
nodes.translate: Hello! The Nine-Dragon Screen is east, the Imperial Garden west.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Look! This dragon has no eyes.

nodes.speaker: shishizi
nodes.translate: Friend — we're here!
nodes.why: Every spirit you have befriended comes to help: the stone lion, the fox, the door gods, the qilin, the pixiu, the Nian beast.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.translate: We'll help you!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: A painted dragon needs its eyes dotted in. You do it!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: 画龙点睛 — the eyes are dotted!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: a painter dotted in the eyes of the dragons he had painted, and they flew away. The finishing touch that brings a thing to life.

nodes.speaker: long
nodes.say: 谢谢你们！我是龙。我们都是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Thank you, all of you! I am the dragon. We're all friends now!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 小神都找到了！他们都回来了！
nodes.translate: We found them all! Every spirit has come back!

nodes.speaker: long
nodes.translate: Hello, friend!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The Imperial Garden! Beautiful.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: We're all here!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: Tomorrow, let's go to the Great Wall!
nodes.why: The end of the story in the city. One more trip: the train from 北京北站 to the Great Wall.

nodes.say: 你好！交通卡要充值吗？五十块。

answers.en: Yes, I'd like to top up.

nodes.translate: Hello! Top up your transport card? Fifty yuan.

nodes.say: 好了！你的交通卡有钱了。
nodes.translate: Done! Your card is topped up.
OK, bye!

nodes.say: 今天是国庆节！你看，人真多！
nodes.translate: It's National Day! Look how many people!
nodes.why: 国庆节, 1 October, begins a week of holidays: the square is full from dawn, when the flag is raised.

nodes.say: 你好！你是第一次来天安门吗？
nodes.translate: Hello! Is this your first time at Tiananmen?

nodes.say: 那你要来看升国旗！天天早上，太阳出来的时候，这里升国旗。
nodes.translate: Then come and see the flag go up! Every morning, when the sun comes up, they raise the flag here.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 升国旗 — to raise the national flag; 太阳出来的时候 — when the sun comes up.

nodes.say: 太阳出来的时候，很多人来这里看。
nodes.translate: When the sun comes up, lots of people come here to watch.

words.explain: 把国旗慢慢地送到上面。
天上很热、很亮的东西。白天有，晚上没有。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: Tiananmen in the morning! So many people!

nodes.say: 早上你来看升国旗了吗？
nodes.translate: Did you come to see the flag go up this morning?

nodes.say: 太好了！国旗很好看吧？很多人天天来看升国旗。
nodes.translate: Great! The flag looks wonderful, doesn't it? Lots of people come to see it every day.

words.explain: 把国旗慢慢地送到上面。

steps.now: The palace needs a ticket booked online in your own name. Ask 王阿姨 at home — she books everything on her phone.
steps.past: 王阿姨 booked my palace ticket on her phone.

steps.now: Go to 天安门 (line 1 to 天安门东), cross the bridge and walk through the gate; show your passport at the security check.
steps.past: Showed my passport at the security check and walked into the palace.

steps.now: Walk north through 午门 to the Hall of Supreme Harmony 太和殿.
steps.past: Walked north through 午门 to the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 feels the last spirit at the Nine-Dragon Screen 九龙壁, east of 太和殿's square.
steps.past: Met the last spirit, the dragon, at the Nine-Dragon Screen.

steps.now: Walk to the Imperial Garden 御花园 — west of 太和殿's square. The spirits are waiting for you there.
steps.past: Found all the spirits waiting in the Imperial Garden.

quests.title: A ticket for the palace
quests.blurb: The palace takes only tickets booked online, in your own name.
quests.lead: The guard at 天安门 says palace tickets are bought online.

steps.now: Palace tickets are booked online in your own name. 王阿姨 books everything on her phone — ask her in the courtyard: 「阿姨，你能帮我买故宫的票吗？」
steps.past: 王阿姨 booked me a palace ticket on her phone.

steps.now: You have a ticket! Go to 天安门 (line 1 to 天安门东), walk to the gate and show your passport at security.
steps.past: Went through security at 午门 into the palace with my own ticket.

quests.title: The flag at sunrise
quests.blurb: Every morning at sunrise the flag goes up on 天安门广场.
quests.lead: The photographer on the square says to come and watch the flag go up at sunrise.

steps.now: Be on 天安门广场 in the morning, before 11:00 — the guard of honour raises the flag (in real life at sunrise; the game keeps it all morning). Sleep at home, then take the subway straight here.
steps.past: Saw the guard of honour raise the flag at sunrise on 天安门广场.

legend.zh: 中国的龙能在天上飞，能在水里住。它会下雨。以前，龙是皇帝的样子。人们说，画龙的时候，最后要画眼睛，龙就会飞走。
legend.en: The Chinese dragon flies in the sky and lives in the water; it brings rain, and it was the emperor's emblem. They say a painted dragon, once its eyes are dotted in, flies away.

befriend.en: Dot in the dragon's eyes — together with every spirit you have found.

idioms.meaning: the finishing touch that brings a thing to life

story.zh: 以前有一个画家，他在墙上画了四个龙，都没有眼睛。别人问他为什么。他说：“画了眼睛，龙就会飞走。”别人不信。他给两个龙画了眼睛，这两个龙真的飞走了！
story.en: A painter drew four dragons on a temple wall, all without eyes. 'If I dot the eyes, they will fly away,' he said. Nobody believed him — so he dotted the eyes of two, and those two flew off into the sky.

title.en: End of chapter one · A new home

steps.en: One figure home — the stone lion. Eight more are out there, somewhere in this city.
Next, the lakes: 后海. People there talk about a fox.

title.en: Paint the dragon, dot the eyes
Paint the dragon, dot the eyes — the finishing touch that brings it to life

steps.en: I've come to see the flag go up!
Sunrise. The guard of honour has marched out of 天安门 and across 长安街 — they stop the traffic for it.

steps.zh: 天天早上，太阳出来的时候，这里升国旗。
steps.en: Every morning, when the sun comes up, the flag goes up here.
The sun is up! Look — the flag!
Hundreds of people got up before dawn for this, and so did you. It happens every single day, and it's free.

words.explain: 把国旗慢慢地送到上面。
天上很热、很亮的东西。白天有，晚上没有。

cards.en: Tiananmen, the Gate of Heavenly Peace

souvenir.en: a little flag from the square

facts.zh: 天安门很老了。一四一七年就有了。
facts.en: It is very old: it was first built in 1417 (as 承天门), and named 天安门 in 1651.
facts.how: Read the gate's name, under the middle arch.

facts.zh: 门前有五个桥。中间的桥，以前只有皇帝能走。
facts.en: Five bridges cross the river before the gate. The middle one was once for the emperor alone.
facts.how: Read the sign by the bridges (金水桥).

facts.zh: 门前门后都有华表。上面的小动物在看皇帝。
facts.en: There are 华表 columns in front of the gate and behind it. People say the little beasts on top keep an eye on the emperor.
facts.how: Look at a 华表 — the carved white columns.

facts.zh: 天天早上，太阳出来的时候，这里升国旗。
facts.en: Every morning at sunrise the national flag is raised here.
facts.how: Come to the square in the morning, before 11:00.

facts.zh: 这是很大很大的广场。中间有一个高高的碑。
facts.en: It is one of the biggest squares in the world, with a tall monument in the middle.
facts.how: Walk across 长安街 by the underpass and find the monument.

facts.zh: 故宫是明朝建的，一四二零年建好。
facts.en: The palace was built under the Ming, finished in 1420.

facts.zh: 大门上有八十一个门钉：九九八十一。
facts.en: The great gates have 81 door studs: nine rows of nine.

facts.zh: 太和殿屋顶上有十个小动物，别的房子没有这么多。
facts.en: Ten little beasts sit on each ridge of its roof — more than on any other building.

facts.zh: 这里是故宫里最大的房子。
facts.en: It is the biggest hall in the palace.
